data.name: Fawad
data.gender_notes: Fawad is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic fuʾād, 'heart, mind'. Its root is ف-ؤ-ا-د (f-ʾ-ā-d). A Qur'anic word; a common Muslim name. Fawad is a Arabic name meaning “Heart; mind”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Fawad expresses “Heart; mind”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fawad total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
